pages.title: Shire
pages.text: England's largest draft horse - taller than a Clydesdale and just as patient. Heavy feathering on all four legs is the breed's signature.

pages.title: Coat
pages.text:
Black, brown, bay and grey are the recognised colours. Chestnut is refused by the British stud book and accepted elsewhere, which makes it a rare sight.

- Black
- Bay
- Brown
- Dark Brown
- Grey
- Chestnut *(rare)*
- Blue Roan *(rare)*
- Bay with Blaze *(rare)*
